instruction: Please convert all the text in the document to lowercase.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting all text to lowercase. Evaluator checks that >= 99% of alphabetic characters are lowercase.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete text extraction: Function only checks paragraph runs but docx files can contain text in tables, headers, footers, text boxes, footnotes, comments, and shapes
For a document titled 'Geography_And_Magical_Realism.docx', there is high likelihood of text in tables or other structures that would be missed
Missing text locations could lead to false positives where uppercase text exists but is not checked
The evaluator would incorrectly return 1.0 (pass) even if uppercase text remains in unchecked locations like table cells or headers
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Extract text from tables: Iterate through doc.tables and check all cell text
Extract text from headers/footers: Check all sections' headers and footers
Extract text from text boxes and shapes: Check drawing elements that may contain text
Consider using a more comprehensive text extraction approach that captures all text content in the document
Example: for table in doc.tables: for row in table.rows: for cell in row.cells: process cell.text
